title: Green Woman at Dusk
description: A close-up portrait of a woman with pale green skin, dark wavy hair, and striking green eyes. She wears red lipstick and a dark purple collar, set against a desolate landscape with a low sunset on the horizon.
prompt: A woman with pale green skin and dark wavy bobbed hair, green eyes with heavy makeup, red lips, looking slightly upward. She wears a dark purple collar. The background is a desolate, muted landscape with a glowing sunset on the horizon under a greenish teal sky. Cinematic lighting, moody atmosphere, realistic oil painting style with visible brush texture.
